title: Sales Battlecard Template With a Filled Example
summary: Download a free sales battlecard template for competitive deals. See where why-we-win, objections, pricing, and proof go, then work a filled example.
body_markdown:
Common section


Where it goes on this card


What to check


Competitor overview


Buyer and decision, with the profile in the evidence sheet


The card needs only what changes this decision.


Why we win


Supported position and proof to offer


Each point has a condition and a source the rep can show.


Why we lose


When the alternative fits


Draw on lost-deal notes and rep feedback, not guesses.


Landmine questions


First question


Ask about a requirement your evidence covers. Do not ask a question that assumes the competitor is weak.


Objection handling


First question, then supported position


Clarify the concern before answering it.


Pricing


Evidence sheet, linked from the card


Cite the competitor's current public pricing page and the date you checked it. Leave out private quotes and discounts unless they are approved for use.


Proof points


Proof to offer


Mark each item as approved to share with buyers or internal only.


Update log


Owner and review


Record who checked the card, when, and what triggers the next review.
